text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH severity — auth-proxy egress traffic spike detected. alert_id=az-9832. Samples saved to /var/log/proxy/egress-sample-03_12.gz. Rate ~4.8k req/min. Possible sensitive header leakage. Paging @carla-sre :rotating_light:

carla-sre: Acknowledged. I'm on pager. Pulling traces, pod list, and recent deploys.

matt-ops: Running `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep auth-proxy` and checking VPC egress rules. Enabling extra NAT logging.

carla-sre: Traces show repeated POSTs to 45.77.22.13:443 from auth-proxy-3/4. Headers include `X-Client-Auth: Bearer <redacted>` pattern — possible token leakage. Grabbing a sandbox curl sample now.

kevin-sec: Tagging as suspected credential exposure. Need to stop traffic to that IP and rotate service tokens ASAP. @matt-ops can you add a temporary deny at the edge and the VPC route table?

matt-ops: Blocking IP at WAF: `wafctl block 45.77.22.13 --reason suspected-exfil`. Also added an explicit egress deny in the VPC. Notifying netinfra to hold any changes.

carla-sre: Draining auth-proxy from LB and setting `RUNTIME_DISABLE_EGRESS=true` via rollout to all pods for immediate mitigation. Starting rolling restart (4 pods) — expect ~1–2m windows per pod.

jordan-support: Any immediate customer impact? Are logins failing or errors spiking downstream?

carla-sre: Expect brief 502s for dependent services during restart; no broad customer login failures reported yet. Monitoring dashboards.

kevin-sec: Begin token rotation plan: 1) create new tokens in KMS, 2) deploy to secret manager, 3) roll secrets into auth-proxy, 4) revoke old tokens. I will own 1–3 but need ops for secret rollout.

matt-ops: Pushing new secret to Vault now and will trigger a rolling deploy with zero-downtime if possible. ETA ~10m.

carla-sre: Found S3 PUTs to `s3://redwood-prod-archive/logs/egress/egress-sampled-03_12.gz` at 03:12:14 UTC — may contain headers. Kevin, please preserve that object and lock access.

liz-legal: Noted. Preserve evidence and restrict access. I'll coordinate disclosure timelines if credentials are confirmed. Tagging CISO.

kevin-sec: Snapshotted the S3 object and applied immutability. Starting parsing to extract possible IOCs. Preparing revocation plan for any exposed tokens.

oncall-bot: Handoff: @carla-sre -> next on-call @matt-ops in 30m. Incident channel created: #inc-4921003333-auth-egress. PagerDuty: PD-8342.

carla-sre: Runbook pointer: `playbooks/incident-auth-egress.md`. Quick grep sample: `zcat egress-sampled-03_12.gz | grep -i 'Authorization:' | head`. Preserving full raw artifact for sec.

jordan-support: Drafting customer communication: short note about unusual auth traffic and investigation underway; will recommend token rotation if confirmed. Any PII involved?

kevin-sec: No confirmed PII so far — signs point to session/service tokens. Will confirm after parsing the artifact. If tokens are present we will advise rotation and invalidate active sessions.

carla-sre: Action items: 1) Matt - confirm firewall block & secret rollout (in progress). 2) Kevin - rotate + revoke tokens; parse logs. 3) Jordan - prepare comms. 4) Liz - legal on-call. I'll continue triage and update every 10m.

matt-ops: Firewall block verified. Vault secret pushed, rolling deploy started (0/4 pods updated).

carla-sre: Rolling deploy finished. Auth-proxy back with egress disabled and new tokens. Observability: egress spike dropped to baseline. Continuing log parsing for scope.

kevin-sec: Old tokens revoked in IAM. Started session invalidation sweep for affected clients and building IOC list (IPs, user-agents, suspicious paths). Will post once complete.

liz-legal: Once token exposure confirmed, coordinate customer notification and regulatory assessment if required. Keep me updated on timing.

jordan-support: Customer note drafted and queued; will send once we have confirmation on token exposure and scope. ETA 30m.

carla-sre: Summary: incident mitigated (egress blocked, tokens rotated, evidence preserved). Creating postmortem ticket PMT-492100 assigned to carla-sre + kevin-sec. Will escalate if any additional artifacts surface. :white_check_mark:
